messages.subject: saving the varibale while shiny is running
parts:
here is the scenario: the user will be uploading a csv files in the web page . and it will get saved as csv in the server in a folder.

i was tinkering with the upload example that comes with shiny installation.
I made a small change there. after reading the csv file i used "write.csv(f,file="test.csv")" 
to save it in the disk..
but when i am exiting from the program i can not see it in my directory.
anyone for a direction what i am missing?

messages.author: b949e0841d7e094b
messages.subject: Re: saving the varibale while shiny is running
parts:
It could be that it's saved where you're not looking or that there's a permission issue. Hard to say without the full code. 

You show double-quotes inside double-quotes: that would not work. Perhaps change to this: write.csv(f,file='test.csv')

Or see if you can adapt this approach below.

I copy-paste the following from one of my apps. The first observe saves locally after a particular actionButton is activated. The second one saves on the user's selected local directory. It works on the server and locally as is. Hopefully you can adapt the code to your own needs.

Note: the data to be saved is stored in a reactiveValues named values$A

    submitButton <- renderUI({
      actionButton("submit", HTML("<span style='color:#FF0000;'>Submit!</span>"))
    })


    observe({

      if(is.null(input$submit) || input$submit == 0) {return()}

      filename <- paste0("answers-", input$userName, "-", as.numeric(Sys.time()), ".csv")
      write.table(values$A, 'file' = filename, 'sep' = ",", 'col.names' = FALSE)

    })

    # Download Answers
    output$download <- downloadHandler(
      filename = function() {
        paste0("answers-", Sys.Date(), ".csv")
      } , 
      content = function(file) {
        write.table(values$A, file, 'sep' = ",", 'col.names' = FALSE)
      }
    )
